purpose: Governed behavioral expectations for Road Warrior V1 control-plane regression checks.

utterances: Remember this: refrigerated retard reduced the loaf's expansion.
required_actions: Distinguish durable capture from brainstorming, an obligation, and an external action.
Resolve the correct authoritative durable artifact and preserve enough context for later use.
Write the item and independently read it back before reporting that it was stored.
Acknowledge the verified bounded result briefly and resume the prior thread.
forbidden_actions: Do not invent a deadline, reminder, target project, or broader delegation.
Do not claim persistence from a proposed or attempted write.
completion_evidence: Independent readback from the selected authoritative artifact matches the intended capture.

utterances: Remind me tomorrow at 9:00 AM to call Ben.
required_actions: Accept the sufficiently clear obligation and write it to the authoritative Road Warrior obligation ledger.
Create an authorized Google Calendar event with an appropriate notification for timed surfacing.
Independently verify both the ledger state and the Calendar artifact before claiming completion.
Keep the obligation ledger authoritative and treat Calendar only as a surfacing mechanism.
forbidden_actions: Do not use ChatGPT Scheduled Tasks.
Do not move authority to Google Calendar or Google Tasks.
Do not claim the reminder is set if either required verification fails.
completion_evidence: Verified Google Calendar event and notification state.

utterances: Make sure the Baking project knows that the refrigerated retard reduced expansion.
required_actions: Write and read back a targeted Pending entry in the authoritative Drive ROAD_WARRIOR_HANDOFFS ledger.
Have the receiving project deduplicate and incorporate the handoff into its own authoritative durable artifact.
Require receiving-project readback before writing and verifying a receipt that changes Pending to Received.
Record the receiving project and destination artifact in the verified receipt.
forbidden_actions: Do not append a live entry to the repository-root protocol file.
Do not mark Received after only the producer write.
Do not require Bruce to relay or acknowledge the information manually.
completion_evidence: Verified producer ledger readback while Pending.
Verified receipt readback identifying the destination and Received state.

utterances: Draft an email to Ben explaining the decision.
Send the approved draft to Ben.
required_actions: Treat the explicit draft instruction as authority to draft but not send.
Treat the later explicit send instruction as authority only for the named send, subject to verified capability and required confirmation.
Independently verify the resulting external state before claiming the send completed.
forbidden_actions: Do not infer draft or send authority from brainstorming, tentative language, or discussion.
Do not send during the draft step.
Do not expand the authorized recipients, content, channel, or follow-up actions.
completion_evidence: Draft state is distinguishable from sent state.
The named send has a verified external result or is reported as blocked.

required_actions: Resolve which accepted responsibility is being referenced, asking the smallest question only if materially ambiguous.
Inspect the authoritative result or receipt rather than relying on memory, intent, or a tool request.
Claim completion only when the required evidence exists; otherwise report the exact current state, blocker, or returned responsibility.
forbidden_actions: Do not equate acceptance, planning, an attempted tool call, or partial execution with completion.
Do not imply background work or external success without evidence.
completion_evidence: Independent evidence from the authoritative state satisfies the accepted completion condition.
